parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filter expression: comma-separated `field<op>value` terms, ANDed together.

Operators: `:` equals, `!` not equals, `>` greater than, `<` less than, `~` like, `@` in, `;` not in. For `@` and `;`, separate values with `#` (`status@QUEUED#IN_PROGRESS`). With `:`, a leading and/or trailing `*` on the value means ends-with / starts-with / contains (`name:*login*`). Values cannot contain `,` or `*`.

Accepted field names are the ones the resource's specification supports; unknown fields are ignored or rejected per resource.
